description: The University of Virginia Biocomplexity project releases a coarse synthetic population for Alabama in the SPW series. Zenodo identifies a public data archive, README, contact matrix and validation figures, with CC BY 4.0 metadata. The README names tables of people, households, residences, activity locations and scheduled assignments, and lists IPUMS, GPW, World Bank and OpenStreetMap-derived inputs. These synthetic households may help define a baseline population distribution for agent-based emergency-service catchment or infrastructure outage simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers Alabama in this series. A limitation is that generated daily activity links are not measured service use or evacuation decisions; emergency behaviour, travel times and facility capacities must come from other sources. The version is described as coarse, with no local calibration reported in the landing-page text. The archive was not downloaded, and no CSV rows or validation statistics were recalculated.
